content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the utena district court the defendant has been ordered to pay a stamp duty fee of €145 the court has decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded the defendant a car an opel vectra the defendant is also ordered to pay the applicant a compensation of eur 1000 and an additional compensation of eur 74995 the legal text discusses three articles in the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant is seeking a postponement of payment for the stamp duty until the courts judgment becomes final the court has ordered the defendant to pay maintenance for the minor children and maintenance arrears the applicant has requested a division of property including the car and the costs of the proceedings the court will determine the amount of costs to be awarded the application to dissolve the marriage has been upheld and the defendant is ordered to pay compensation to the applicant and a stamp duty to the state
